contact.hours: Mon to Fri 7am to 6pm, Sat 7am to 12pm

products.name: Service Filter Kit – 5 Filters
products.desc: Everything for a standard oil service in one box: engine oil filter, fuel filter kit, fuel pre-filter / water separator, engine air filter and cabin pollen filter. $20 less than buying them separately.

products.name: Engine Oil Filter
products.desc: Engine oil filter element (cartridge type) for the OM471 and OM473 engines in the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros. Fits inside the plastic filter housing on the engine and comes with new O-rings. Change it at every oil service, and match the number on your old element: it replaces OE A 472 184 04 25 and the A 473 180 00 09 / A 472 180 01 09 family, and is the same size as MAHLE OX 832D, MANN HU 12 001 z and Hengst E510H07 D129.

products.name: Engine Oil Filter (Slim Base)
products.desc: Oil filter element in the newer slim-base style. Check your old filter: if it narrows at the bottom and carries A 473 180 05 09 or A 473 180 08 09, this is the one. Text us your VIN if unsure.

products.name: Fuel Filter Kit
products.desc: Main fuel filter kit for the OM471 / OM473: filter element, small mesh pre-strainer and O-rings. Keeps dirt out of the injection system. Change at every service.

products.name: Engine Air Filter
products.desc: Engine air filter element for the OM471 and OM473 engines in the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros. A blocked air filter costs power and fuel, so check it at every service and replace it when the restriction indicator shows or at least once a year, sooner on dusty roads. Same size as MAHLE LX 5437, MANN C 50 004/1 and Hengst E2059L. Note the element is about 491 mm long, so it ships in its own box.

products.name: Cabin Pollen Filter
products.desc: Cab pollen filter for the heater and air conditioning on the MP4 / MP5 cab. Replace yearly or when airflow drops. A carbon version (A 960 830 01 18) is also fitted to some trucks, so send us your VIN if unsure.

products.name: AdBlue Pump Filter
products.desc: AdBlue (urea, DEF) pump filter for the SCR emissions system on the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros. A blocked AdBlue filter starves the dosing pump, which can bring up an emissions warning and put the truck into derate (limp mode). Change it with the AdBlue system service. MAHLE lists UX 13KIT (OE A 000 142 05 89) for MP4 / MP5 trucks; check the number on your old filter or send us your VIN.

products.name: Fuel Pre-filter / Water Separator
products.desc: Spin-on fuel pre-filter / water separator can for the OM471 / OM473, supplied with a new O-ring. Traps water and coarse dirt before the main fuel filter. Change at every service and drain water as needed.

products.name: Power Steering Filter
products.desc: Power steering hydraulic filter for the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros. Replace it whenever you change the steering fluid, or if the steering feels heavy or the pump is noisy. MAHLE lists HX 15 (OE A 000 184 22 25) for MP4 / MP5 trucks; check the number on your old filter or send us your VIN.

products.name: Air Dryer Cartridge
specs: Spin-on desiccant cartridge with oil separator
Every 1 to 2 years, or when water shows in the air tanks
products.desc: Spin-on air dryer cartridge with oil separator for the air processing unit on the MP4 Mercedes-Benz Actros. Keeps water and oil out of the brake air system. Change it every 1 to 2 years, or sooner if you're draining water from the tanks. Check your old cartridge has the M41 x 2 thread before you order, or send us your VIN and we'll confirm fit. New stock is on its way.

products.name: Brake Hose Set with M22 Connectors
products.desc: Brake hose (OE A 002 420 93 48) supplied as a set with 2 brass push-in connectors (OE A 000 997 81 34, M22x1.5 thread, with seals), ready to fit.

products.name: Front Brake Pad Set (Axle Set)
specs: 4 pads plus repair kit, enough for one front axle (both wheels)
products.desc: Front axle brake pad set for the MP4 Mercedes-Benz Actros with Knorr-Bremse SM7 disc brakes. 4 pads plus a repair kit, enough to do both front wheels. Front and rear pads are different sizes, so check the WVA number on your old pad (29246 or 29247) before you order, or send us your VIN and we'll confirm fit. If your old pads say WVA 29315 you have Wabco MAXX22L calipers and these won't fit. New stock is on its way.

products.name: Rear Brake Pad Set (Axle Set)
specs: 4 pads plus repair kit, enough for one rear axle (both wheels)
products.desc: Rear axle brake pad set for the MP4 Mercedes-Benz Actros with Knorr-Bremse SL7 disc brakes. 4 pads plus a repair kit, enough to do both wheels on one rear axle (order 2 sets for a tandem drive). Front and rear pads are different sizes, so check the WVA number on your old pad (29244 or 29245) before you order, or send us your VIN and we'll confirm fit. If your old pads say WVA 29315 you have Wabco MAXX22L calipers and these won't fit. New stock is on its way.

products.name: ABS/EBS Suzi Coil – 7 Core ISO 7638 Trailer Cable
specs: Trailer ABS/EBS brakes and roll stability control
Coiled suzi with spring-latched plugs and dust caps
products.desc: ABS/EBS 7 core trailer plug cable for trailer stability control. A coiled suzi with ISO 7638 7-pin plugs at both ends that carries power and data between the prime mover and the trailer's ABS/EBS brake module (Wabco, Knorr-Bremse or Haldex), including roll stability control. Suits the MP4 Mercedes-Benz Actros and any prime mover and trailer with ISO 7638 sockets, and replaces Narva, Hella and Trail Link 7 core EBS suzi coils. Replace it if the trailer ABS/EBS warning light comes on, the plugs are loose or cracked, or the coil is cut or flattened.

products.name: 7 Pin Trailer Suzi Coil – Lighting Cable
specs: Coiled suzi with metal-bodied plugs and spring guard
products.desc: 7 pin coiled suzi that carries the trailer light circuits (tail, stop, indicators and auxiliary) from the prime mover to the trailer. Metal-bodied plugs with a spring guard to stop the cable kinking at the plug. An alternative to Narva, Hella and Trail Link 7 core trailer suzi coils. For the trailer brakes' ABS/EBS connection use our ABS/EBS suzi coil. Check the plug on your truck and trailer matches before you order, or call us and we'll confirm.

products.name: Main Mirror Cover (Long)
products.desc: Replacement back cover for the long main mirror (long-arm mirror). Left-hand / passenger side is OE A 960 811 06 07, right-hand / driver's side is OE A 960 811 07 07. Choose your side.

products.name: H7 24V 70W Headlight Globes (Pair)
specs: Headlight low beam (check your old globe for high beam)
products.desc: A pair of H7 24 volt 70 watt halogen headlight globes with the PX26d base, for the halogen headlights on the MP4 Mercedes-Benz Actros. Change both sides together so the beams match. Pull your old globe and check it says H7 24V before you order.

products.name: Corner Mirror Cover (Small)
products.desc: Replacement back cover for the small corner (lower, wide-angle) mirror that sits under the main mirror. Left-hand / passenger side is OE A 960 811 14 07, right-hand / driver's side is OE A 960 811 15 07. Choose your side. Pairs with our long main mirror cover.

products.name: Side Marker Light (Amber Clearance Lamp)
specs: Two mounting studs, right-angle bulb holder at the back
products.desc: Amber side marker (side clearance) light with a built-in reflector for the Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 and MP5. Clips in on two studs with a right-angle bulb holder at the back, and fits either side. Replace a cracked, faded or water-filled lens and stay roadworthy. Sold each, so order as many as you need.

products.name: Viscous Fan Clutch
products.desc: Viscous fan clutch (viscous coupling) for the engine cooling fan on the OM471 MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros. Signs it has failed: the engine runs hot on hills or in traffic, the fan roars all the time, or oil is leaking from the hub. Replaces OE A 470 200 07 22, same as MAHLE CFC 173 000P, NRF 49159 and Nissens 86140.

products.name: Coolant Expansion Tank
products.desc: Coolant expansion tank (header tank) for the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros. The plastic tank cracks with age and heat, so coolant loss, a sweet smell or crusty coolant around the tank are the usual signs. Replace the cap at the same time if it doesn't hold pressure. Replaces OE A 960 501 42 03 (also A 960 501 87 03), same as MAHLE CRT 235 000P and Nissens 996053.

products.name: Radiator
specs: Aluminium core, plastic tanks, with frame
products.desc: Engine coolant radiator with frame for the MP4 and MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros (OM470, OM471 and OM473). Replace if the core is leaking, blocked or the engine runs hot. Mercedes used a few radiator part numbers on these trucks, so check the number on your old radiator or send us your VIN and we'll confirm fit before you order. It's a big item, so freight is quoted to your door, or pick up free in Victoria. New stock is on its way.

products.name: Top Radiator Hose
products.desc: Top (upper) radiator hose to suit the MP4 and MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros, OE A 960 501 61 93. It carries hot coolant from the engine to the top of the radiator. Replace it if it's split, swollen, soft or weeping coolant at the clamps, and it's worth doing whenever the radiator comes out. Check the number on your old hose or send us your VIN and we'll confirm fit before you order. New stock is on its way.

products.name: Clutch Kit
products.desc: Complete clutch kit for the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros with the PowerShift automated gearbox: clutch plate (disc), pressure plate and release bearing. Signs it's due: slipping under load, juddering when taking off, or a clutch wear warning on the dash. Clutch kits differ by gearbox and engine, so send us your VIN and we'll confirm the right kit before you pay.

products.name: Clutch Actuator (PowerShift)
products.desc: Clutch actuator (clutch servo) for the PowerShift automated manual gearbox in the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros. A failing actuator causes rough or slow take-offs, the clutch not fully releasing, air leaks at the actuator, or clutch fault codes on the dash. Send us your VIN and we'll confirm it matches your gearbox before you pay.

products.name: Starter Motor 24V 7.5kW
products.desc: 24V 7.5kW starter motor for the OM471 and OM473 engines in the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros, including the Actros 2658. Replace it if the engine cranks slowly with good batteries, the starter clicks but doesn't turn, or it grinds on engagement. Replaces OE A 007 151 45 01, same as MAHLE MS 754 and Prestolite (TRP 1549007).

products.name: Cylinder Liner Kit (OM473)
products.desc: Cylinder liner kit for the OM473 15.6 litre engine in the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros (2658, 2663), for an in-frame or out-of-frame engine rebuild. Liner kits vary by piston and engine build, so send us your VIN or engine number and we'll confirm the right kit and lead time. Not for the OM471 12.8 litre, which has a smaller bore and different liners.

products.name: Engine Timing Tool Kit
products.desc: Engine timing tool kit for the OM471 and OM473 engines in the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros. Locks the camshafts and crankshaft in position for timing work, cylinder head jobs and cam replacement. Ask us what's in the kit and the lead time.

products.name: Cylinder Head (OM473)
products.desc: Complete bare cylinder head for the OM473 (also listed for the OM472 and the DD15 / DD16). One in stock. Freight isn't included: it's quoted on request, or pick up free in Melbourne. Send us your VIN or engine number and we'll confirm fit before you pay. Not for the OM471 12.8 litre, which uses a different head.

products.name: Oil Spinner (Crankcase Oil Separator)
products.desc: Oil spinner (crankcase ventilation oil separator) for the OM471 and OM473 engines. Check the number on your old unit matches A 471 010 01 62 or A 472 010 31 62, or send us your VIN and we'll confirm.

products.name: Battery Terminal Sensor (Negative)
products.desc: Battery sensor on the negative battery terminal. Check the number on your old sensor matches A 012 542 62 18, or send us your VIN and we'll confirm.

products.name: Pneumatic Oil Drum Pump with Hose and Metered Gun
products.desc: Air-operated pump for dispensing engine oil from a drum, supplied with a 5 m delivery hose and a metered dispensing gun that shows how much oil has been pumped. Runs off workshop compressed air. Suits any truck or workshop.
specs: Handles thick oils up to 1200 SAE (maker's rating)

products.name: Holset Turbocharger (OM473)
specs: Holset (HE500WG or HX55 depending on build, check your tag)
products.desc: Holset turbocharger for the OM473 15.6 litre engine in the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros 2658 and 2663 (also listed for the Detroit DD15 / DD16). Signs your turbo is failing: loss of power or boost, blue or black smoke, oil in the intercooler pipes, or a loud whistle or siren noise. Mercedes used two turbo styles on the OM473 (Holset HE500WG and HX55) under several part numbers, so check the number on your old turbo's tag matches one of these, or text us your VIN and we'll confirm fit before you pay. Fix the cause of the old turbo failing (oil feed, air leaks, blocked filter) before fitting the new one. Fit new exhaust manifold gaskets (A 472 142 18 80 / A 472 142 19 80) while it's off. Not for the OM471 12.8 litre: it uses a different turbo. Freight is quoted to your door, or pick up free in Victoria.

products.name: Exhaust Manifold Gasket (OM473)
products.desc: Aftermarket exhaust manifold gasket to suit the OM473 15.6 litre engine in the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros 2658 and 2663. Replace it if you hear an exhaust tick or blow at the manifold, see soot marks around the manifold joints, or whenever the manifold or turbo comes off. There are two: A 472 142 18 80 for cylinders 1-3 and A 472 142 19 80 for cylinders 4-6. Pick the position you need, and add one of each to do the whole engine. Priced per gasket. Not for the OM471 12.8 litre: its manifold gaskets are A 471 142 01 80 (cylinders 1-3) and A 471 142 02 80 (cylinders 4-6), so check the number on your old gasket.

products.name: Injector Line Seal (OM471 / OM473)
specs: Valve cover, where the fuel injector line passes through (1 per cylinder)
Rubber seal bonded to a two-bolt metal flange, marked TOP
products.desc: Aftermarket fuel injector line seal to suit the OM471 and OM473 engines in the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros, OE A 472 078 04 80 (also listed as A 472 078 01 80). It seals the injector line where it passes through the valve cover, so a hard or split one lets oil weep onto the lines and down the side of the head. There's one per cylinder, six per engine, and it's worth replacing them whenever the valve cover comes off or the injectors are done. Fit it with TOP facing up. Priced per seal.
